description: Special servicing, workout and liquidation fees on a CMBS loan for one outcome (loan corrected and paid at maturity, refinanced within 120 days of a missed maturity, or liquidated/discounted payoff), using the fee terms of a real 2025 pooling and servicing agreement: 0.25%/yr with a $3,500 monthly minimum, 1% workout fee with a $25,000 minimum, 1% to 3% liquidation fee. Returns each fee, the monthly fee and the total.

months_in_special_servicing.description: Months the loan spends with the special servicer, e.g. 9.

months_to_maturity.description: Months from the loan's return to maturity, e.g. 30. Needed for outcome "corrected".

note_rate_pct.description: Note rate in percent, e.g. 4.5. Needed for outcome "corrected" (the workout fee applies to interest collections).

outcome.description: corrected = three on-time payments, the loan returns and pays off at maturity; refi120 = missed balloon only, refinanced or repaid within 120 days of maturity; payoff = discounted payoff, note sale, foreclosure or other liquidation.

proceeds.description: Payoff or liquidation proceeds in dollars. Needed for outcome "payoff".

name: estimate_special_servicing_fees
title: Estimate CMBS special servicing fees
